question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Ancient Indians were never this ______ minded.
solution:
The correct answer is "**narrow.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct word to use in the blank is "narrow" as it will complete the phrase "narrow-minded."**
 
• **"Narrow-minded" is a common phrase in English that means someone who is unwilling to consider different ideas or perspectives**.(संकीर्ण सोच वाला)
 
• The opposite of "narrow-minded" is "open-minded," meaning someone who is receptive to new ideas and experiences.(खुले विचारों वाला)
 
• In this context, the sentence suggests that ancient Indians were more open-minded than people today.
 
• The use of the word "this" implies that the speaker is comparing ancient Indians to modern-day people, rather than to people from another time period.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• Ancient Indians were never this narrow minded.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Slim" typically refers to something that is thin or slender, such as a person's figure or a piece of clothing.(छरहरा)
 
• "Tiny" means very small, often to the point of being insignificant or difficult to see.(छोटा)
 
• "Cramp" can be a verb meaning to restrict or limit, or a noun referring to a painful muscle spasm.(ऐंठन)
